cards.ex: We decided to ride it out at home rather than evacuate, hoping the storm wouldn't be too bad.
cards.exUz: Biz evakuatsiya qilmasdan, uyda o'tirishga qaror qildik, umid qilib bo'ron unchalik yomon bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir xavfli vaziyatdan sabr bilan o'tib olish, uni kutib turish.

cards.ex: The new safety regulations will go into effect next month after the factory fire.
cards.exUz: Yangi xavfsizlik qoidalari kelasi oy zavoddagi yong'indan keyin kuchga kiradi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun yoki qoida ish boshlamoq, amalga osha boshlamoq.

cards.ex: The entire forest turned to ashes after the lightning strike.
cards.exUz: Chaqmoq urishi natijasida butun o'rmon kulga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Yong'in natijasida butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketmoq, kulga aylanmoq.

cards.ex: Quick thinking by the pilot was key to averting disaster when the engine failed.
cards.exUz: Uchuvchining tezkor fikrlashi dvigatel ishdan chiqqanida fojiani oldini olishda muhim rol o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon hodisaning yuzaga kelishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik, uning oldini olish.

cards.ex: Brace yourself, I have some bad news about the flood damage.
cards.exUz: O'zingni tayyorla, menda suv toshqini zarari haqida yomon xabar bor.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik yoki yomon xabarga ruhiy jihatdan tayyorlanmoq.

cards.ex: In the wake of the hurricane, there's a lot of cleaning up to do.
cards.exUz: To'fondan so'ng juda ko'p tozalash ishlari bor.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir hodisadan keyin yuzaga keladigan oqibatlar natijasida.

cards.ex: The community is slowly picking up the pieces after the earthquake destroyed so many homes.
cards.exUz: Zilzila ko'p uylarni vayron qilganidan so'ng, jamiyat asta-sekin hayotni qayta tiklamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Fojia yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan so'ng hayotni qayta tiklashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Against all odds, they managed to rescue everyone from the burning building.
cards.exUz: Barcha qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, ular yonayotgan binodan hamma odamni qutqarishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: The city is on high alert due to the increased risk of terrorist attacks.
cards.exUz: Terroristik hujumlar xavfi oshganligi sababli shahar yuqori tayyorgarlikda.
cards.uzDef: Xavf xatari yuqori bo'lganligi sababli, doimo hushyor va tayyor holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: It was a narrow escape for the family when the landslide hit their house.
cards.exUz: Yer ko'chkisi ularning uyiga urilganda, oila uchun mo'jizaviy qutulish bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xavfli vaziyatdan zo'rg'a qutulib qolish.

cards.ex: The factory closure had a ripple effect on the entire town's economy.
cards.exUz: Zavodning yopilishi butun shahar iqtisodiyotiga zanjir reaksiya ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir hodisa boshqa ko'plab hodisalarga ta'sir qilishi, zanjir kabi.

cards.ex: Even after losing everything in the fire, they're trying to count their blessings and stay positive.
cards.exUz: Yong'inda hamma narsasini yo'qotgan bo'lsa ham, ular shukr qilib, ijobiy bo'lishga harakat qilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi narsalaringiz uchun minnatdor bo'lmoq, yomon vaziyatda ham yaxshi tomonlarni ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: Many small businesses fell victim to the economic downturn caused by the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina kichik bizneslar pandemiya sababli iqtisodiy pasayishga qurbon bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir yomon ta'siriga tushmoq, qurbon bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The hospital was under siege as they struggled to cope with the influx of patients.
cards.exUz: Kasalxona bemorlar oqimi bilan kurashishga urinayotganda qamal ostida edi.
cards.uzDef: Qamal qilingan, hujumga uchragan, qiyin ahvolda.

cards.ex: People are desperately trying to sandbag their homes to protect them from the rising floodwaters.
cards.exUz: Odamlar uylarini ko'tarilayotgan suvdan himoya qilish uchun umidsizlik bilan qum to'ldirilgan qoplarni qo'yishga harakat qilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Suv sathi ko'tarilib, toshqin xavfini keltirib chiqarmoqda.

cards.ex: The government is trying to stem the tide of misinformation spreading online after the earthquake.
cards.exUz: Hukumat zilziladan so'ng internetda tarqalgan noto'g'ri ma'lumot oqimini to'xtatishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir yomonlashuvini to'xtatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The refugees are in dire straits, lacking food and clean water.
cards.exUz: Qochqinlar og'ir ahvolda, ularda oziq-ovqat va toza suv yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Juda qiyin va xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The hikers struggled against the elements as the blizzard intensified.
cards.exUz: Sayohatchilar qor bo'roni kuchaygan sayin tabiatga qarshi kurashdilar.
cards.uzDef: Og'ir ob-havo sharoitlariga qarshi kurashish.

cards.ex: The rescue efforts went down to the wire, but they managed to find the missing child.
cards.exUz: Qutqaruv ishlari so'nggi daqiqagacha davom etdi, ammo ular yo'qolgan bolani topishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt tugashiga oz qolganda, juda kech bo'lganda.

cards.ex: The coastline took a battering from the hurricane.
cards.exUz: Sohil chizig'i to'fondan jiddiy zarar ko'rdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta zarar ko'rmoq, yomon ob-havo yoki boshqa narsalar ta'sirida.

cards.ex: Flash flooding caused chaos in the city after the heavy rain.
cards.exUz: Kuchli yomg'irdan so'ng to'satdan suv toshqini shaharda tartibsizlikni keltirib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va kutilmaganda yuzaga keladigan suv toshqini.

cards.ex: After the scandal, the company is on shaky ground and may not survive.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan so'ng kompaniya noaniq vaziyatda va omon qolmasligi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noaniq vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The silver lining of the disaster is how the community came together to help each other.
cards.exUz: Fojianing umid nuri shundaki, jamiyat bir-biriga yordam berish uchun birlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatda ham yaxshi bir narsa topish, umid qilish.

cards.ex: Doctors and nurses are on the front lines of the pandemic, risking their own lives.
cards.exUz: Shifokorlar va hamshiralar pandemiya oldingi saflarida, o'z hayotlarini xavf ostiga qo'yishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Eng xavfli joyda, yordam ko'rsatish uchun.

cards.ex: The early warning system was crucial in averting the worst of the tsunami.
cards.exUz: Erta ogohlantirish tizimi tsunamining eng yomon oqibatlarining oldini olishda muhim edi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yomon oqibatlarning yuzaga kelishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.

cards.ex: In the face of adversity, the community showed incredible resilience.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, jamiyat ajoyib chidamlilik ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatga qaramay, bardosh berish, harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Volunteers are working at ground zero to help search for survivors.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilar omon qolganlarni qidirishda yordam berish uchun hodisa markazida ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hodisa yuz bergan joyning markazida.

cards.ex: Diplomacy played a key role in averting a crisis between the two countries.
cards.exUz: Diplomatiya ikki davlat o'rtasidagi krizisning oldini olishda muhim rol o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Krizis vaziyatiga yo'l qo'ymaslik, uni bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: The company is on thin ice after the environmental disaster.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhit halokatidan so'ng kompaniya xavfli vaziyatda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli, noaniq yoki muammoli vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Spirtli ichimliklarni ichish va mashina haydash - fojia sababi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatni keltirib chiqaradigan holatlar kombinatsiyasi.
